description: This file defines the NoteWritePlatformService interface in the Fineract project, specifying methods for creating, updating, deleting, and associating notes with clients and loan transactions.

classes.name: NoteWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for note-related operations within the Fineract core portfolio module, including creating, updating, deleting, and associating notes with clients and transactions.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createLoanTransactionNote
methods.description: Creates a note associated with a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createAndPersistClientNote
methods.description: Creates and associates a note with a client.
